recentItems.description:
#SanjayKumarACP #CrimeDiaries #IDreamNews #PoliceInterview #TelanganaPolice #GaneshNimarjan #RealLifeHeroes #LawEnforcement #TrueCrimeStories,
Sanjay Kumar Retd ACP Exclusive Interview | Crime Diaries with Muralidhar | Ganesh Nimarjan Dance? 

In this exclusive episode of Crime Diaries with Muralidhar, we sit down with Retired ACP Sanjay Kumar (1995 batch) for a candid, no-holds-barred conversation about his extraordinary journey from being a school teacher to becoming a fearless police officer. Watch the full interview to explore the untold stories behind his 30-year service, high-stakes operations, and life in the police department:

From Teacher to Police Officer: How an accidental entry into the police force changed his life, leaving behind the classroom to wear the uniform.

Naxalite Confrontations & Threats: Heart-pounding memories from his early posting days, dealing with Naxalite threats, village resistance, and escaping close calls.

The Viral Ganesh Immersion Dance: The truth behind his energetic dance during the Ganesh Nimarjan procession, handling massive crowds, and why connecting with the public on the ground matters.

Service, Promotions, & Retirement: Unpacking the reality of missing out on a final promotion just before retirement, clearing up rumors about taking VRS, and ensuring a grand exit.

Tough Postings & Saifabad Memories: Managing high-pressure situations, constant protests, dharnas, and dealing with the toughest police jurisdictions in Telangana.

Interactions with Senior IPS Officers: Sharing lighthearted and intense moments with senior officers, including being called "Amitabh Bachchan" and getting the nickname "Agni" in Rayadurgam.

Tribute to Police Families: A heartfelt salute to the wives and families of police officers who silently endure hardships and manage households while their partners serve society 24/7.

Advice for Aspiring Police Personnel: Why joining the police department is a blessing, the importance of dedication, and practical advice for newcomers stepping into law enforcement.
